latest_release.name: v3.7.0
latest_release.body:
## 🚀 New

- Update fasthttp to v1.78.0 (#4779, #4803, #4862)
  fasthttp v1.78.0 (from v1.75.0) hardens request framing, multipart parsing, redirects and file serving, and speeds up path normalization, query parsing, header setters and `Client.Do`.
  https://github.com/valyala/fasthttp/releases/tag/v1.78.0
- Support map fields in query and form binding (#4788)
  Struct fields of type `map[string]T` now bind from query strings and form bodies; `attributes[color]` and `attributes.color` both give the key `color`.
  ```go
  type Filter struct {
      Attributes map[string]string   `query:"attributes"` // ?attributes[color]=red&attributes.size=m
      Tags       map[string][]string `query:"tags"`       // ?tags[sale]=yes&tags[sale]=new
      Limits     map[string]int      `query:"limits"`     // ?limits[max]=5
  }
  ```
  https://docs.gofiber.io/api/bind#map-fields
- Add AllowSymlinksOutsideRoot to the static middleware (#4803)
  A root on disk is now confined: symbolic links that leave it, and absolute ones, are handled like missing files unless `AllowSymlinksOutsideRoot` is set.
  ```go
  app.Use("/assets", static.New("./public", static.Config{
      AllowSymlinksOutsideRoot: true, // default: false
  }))
  ```
  https://docs.gofiber.io/middleware/static#config
- Let proxy.DoRedirects and the Fiber client drop extra sensitive headers on a redirect (#4800)
  New opt-in `RedirectSensitiveHeaders` on `proxy.SecurityPolicy` and the client (`Client`, `Request`, `Config`) names headers such as `X-Api-Key` that a redirect to another origin (proxy) or host (client) drops; empty by default.
  ```go
  policy := proxy.DefaultSecurityPolicy()
  policy.RedirectSensitiveHeaders = []string{"X-Api-Key", "X-Auth-Token"}
  proxy.WithSecurityPolicy(policy)

  cli := client.New().SetRedirectSensitiveHeaders("X-Api-Key")
  ```
  https://docs.gofiber.io/middleware/proxy#headers-on-a-cross-origin-redirect

## 🧹 Updates

- Share host splitting and IDNA folding (#4851)
- Align forwarded header list parsing (#4847)
- Share forwarded IP scanning and ignore empty elements (#4820)
- Share redirect URL normalization (#4824)
- Speed up media type parameter parsing (#4807)
- Avoid allocations for empty typed lookups (#4852)
- Consolidate control-character scanning (#4783)
- cache/limiter: Walk Cache-Control lists with headerlist and write Retry-After without a string (#4833)
- cors/csrf: Share origin allow-list parsing (#4836)
- encryptcookie: Build the AEAD once per middleware instead of per cookie (#4838)
- etag: Checksum bodies with slicing-by-8 (#4794)
- limiter: Format rate-limit header values without allocating (#4822)
- proxy: Copy the forwarder name before storing it in the refused-request test (#4819)
- redirect/rewrite: Share pattern compilation (#4846)
- Share the client cookie jar host normalization (#4844)
- Share the value-redaction helper across middleware (#4821)
- Deduplicate the unit tests with shared helpers (#4825)
- Use a nolint:revive directive on App.Handler (#4831)

## 🐛 Fixes

- Stop optional path parameters from swallowing a slash (#4778)
- Stat the index for directory SendFile ranges and move the path guards into internal/fspath (#4769)
- Skip empty forwarded host and proto elements and restore the Next loop (#4856)
- Preserve nil first field lines when joining headers (#4840)
- Return an empty charset when its value is not a token (#4781)
- Preserve redirects and errors in Fresh checks (#4811)
- Trim the whitespace around comma-split header values in Bind (#4793)
- Reject out-of-range int and uint in generic parsers on 32-bit (#4832)
- Make Links add to the Link header instead of replacing it (#4829)
- Serve a request with a TLS state over TLS in app.Test (#4839)
- Send the measured Content-Length of an unsized body in app.Test (#4830)
- Make Listen return when GracefulContext is done during startup (#4770)
- cache: End cached entries when a revalidation is refused
